[Snowflake-like Capsules for Hydration & Barrier Care] Snowflake-like micro-capsules release Squalane and Thioctic Acid on contact, supporting the skin's moisture barrier and restore a healthy, radiant glow. [Dermatologist-Tested & Gentle] Clinically tested and proven suitable for all skin types, including delicate skin. *Clinical Tested by the Global Institute of Dermatological Sciences/ Results may vary depending on individual skin types.
